name: bowerbirds
description: Bowerbirds for coding agents: the records skill, a route template that turns bug captures into Linear issues, and the Linear remote MCP connector it expects.

routeTemplates.name: Bugs to Linear
routeTemplates.description: Captures and notes that report a bug become Linear issues. Delegate a record here when it describes something broken, wrong or unexpected in a product, with or without a screenshot.
routeTemplates.goal: One Linear issue per distinct bug, with the capture's comments as the reproduction steps and a comment on the existing issue when the bug is already filed.
routeTemplates.rules: Search the team's issues before creating one: a record about a bug that already has an issue is an append (a comment with the new detail) or a link, never a second issue. Three records about one bug in a batch are one create and two appends. Do not create an issue from a record that asks a question, proposes a feature or is a note to self — answer none. Never delete, close or edit an existing issue.
